overview: Four-centre cohort from provincial data, 2023 to 2026, comparing changes in 30-day readmission and 90-day cost before and after March 2025 at adopting centres (A, B) with comparison centres (C, D), with a within-cohort cost per readmission avoided.
population: Adults discharged alive after coronary bypass, valve or combined surgery at the four centres from January 2023 to December 2026; first surgery per patient; about 3,600 discharges per year.
exposure: Discharge from centre A or B after March 2025, when remote monitoring was offered; platform logs give monitoring days completed.
procedures: The data institute links discharge abstracts, billing and platform logs; case mix from diagnosis and procedure codes (age, sex, frailty index, ejection fraction category, urgency, procedure type); costs from provincial case costing; centre-level annual volume.

outcomes.name: 30-day all-cause readmission
outcomes.measure: Any admission within 30 days of discharge
outcomes.why: The effect that drives both benefit and cost.

outcomes.name: 90-day health system cost
outcomes.measure: Provincial case-costed hospital, emergency and physician costs plus programme cost
outcomes.why: The cost side of the ministry's question.

outcomes.name: Monitoring days completed
outcomes.measure: Days with transmitted readings out of 30 at A and B

outcomes.name: Alert-driven extra contacts
outcomes.measure: Unplanned calls or visits triggered by alerts
outcomes.why: Alerts can add worry and contacts.

feasibility: About 14,400 discharges across four years; analysis within the data institute's environment by June 2027.
biasMitigation: Before-and-after contrast at all four centres

biasFlags.label: Few clusters
biasFlags.note: Two adopting and two comparison centres.

biasFlags.label: Non-parallel pre-adoption trends
biasFlags.note: Checked graphically and with an event-study model.

flags: Seven case-mix covariates fixed in advance
parsimony.simplestPath: One before-and-after contrast between two pairs of centres, one primary outcome, one cost ratio.

theoreticalFramework: Target trial emulation to define time zero at discharge and eligibility.
summary: Four-centre cohort with before-and-after contrasts and costs.
